6.    SEGMENT INFORMATION                                                           6.   分部資料
      HKFRS 8 “Operating Segments” (“HKFRS 8”) requires operating                         香 港 財 務 申 報 準 則 第 8 號「 經 營 分 部 」
      segments to be identified on the basis of internal reports about                   （「香港財務申報準則第8號」）要求以本
      components of the Group that are regularly reviewed by the executive                公司執行董事為主要營運決策者（「主要
      directors of the Company, who are the Chief Operating Decision                      營運決策者」）在對分部作資源分配及評
      Makers (“CODM”), in order to allocate resources to segments and                     估其表現上所定期審閱的有關本集團不
      to assess their performance. Specifically, the Group’s reportable                   同部門之內部報告作為確定經營分部之
      segments under HKFRS 8 are organised into six main operating                        基準。具體而言，在香港財務申報準則
      divisions – (i) laminates, (ii) PCBs, (iii) chemicals, (iv) properties, (v)         第8號下，本集團之申報分部分為六個
      investments (mainly investment income from debt instruments at                      主要經營分部－(i)覆銅面板、(ii)印刷線
      FVTOCI and equity instruments at FVTPL) and (vi) others (mainly                     路板、(iii)化工產品、(iv)物業、(v)投資
      including service income, manufacture and sale of magnetic products                （主要包括按公平值計入其他全面收益
      and hotel business).                                                                的債務工具及按公平值計入損益的權益
                                                                                          工具的投資收入）     及(vi)其他（主要包括服
                                                                                          務收入、製造及銷售磁電產品及酒店業
                                                                                          務）。
      The accounting policies the Group used for segment reporting under
      HKFRS 8 are the same as those used in its HKFRS consolidated                       本集團根據香港財務申報準則第8號用
      financial statements. Segment results represent the profit earned                  作分部呈報之會計政策，與其用於香港
      by/loss from each segment with certain items not included (share                   財務申報準則之綜合財務報表一致。分
      of result of an associate, share of results of joint ventures, finance             部業績代表各分部賺取的利潤╱虧損但

14. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (continued)                                            14. 投資物業（續）
      In determining the fair value of the relevant properties, the Directors      為釐定相關物業的公平值，董事已成立
      have set up a valuation committee, which is headed up by the                 估值委員會，由負責本集團財務事務的

      The average credit period on purchase of goods is 90 days (2022: 90           購 買 貨 品 的 平 均 信 貸 期 為 90 日（ 二 零
      days). The Group has financial risk management policies in place to           二二年：90日）。本集團現行財務風險

      The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will     資本風險管理本集團管理其資本以確保
      be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to       通過優化債務與股本結存為權益持有人

      The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.             持續經營。本集團之整體策略與過往年
                                                                                  度相同。

      The capital structure of the Group consists of bank borrowings              誠如綜合權益變動表所披露，本集團之
      and lease liabilities, net of cash and cash equivalents and equity          資本結構包括銀行借貸及租賃負債（扣
      attributable to owners of the Company, comprising issued share              除現金及現金等值項目）及本公司持有
      capital, share premium, reserves and retained profits as disclosed in       人應佔權益（包括已發行股本、股份溢
      the consolidated statement of changes in equity.                            價、儲備及保留溢利）。

      The Directors review the capital structure on a semi-annual basis.          董事每半年審閱資本結構。作為審閱一
      As part of this review, the Directors consider the cost of capital and      部分，董事將考慮資本成本，及與各類
      the risks associated with each class of capital. In the opinion of the      別資本相關之風險。董事認為，本集團
      Directors, the Group will balance its overall capital structure through     將通過支付股息、發行新股、購回股
      the payment of dividends, new share issues and share buy-backs as           份、發行新債或者贖回現有債項，以平
      well as the issue of new debt or the redemption of existing debt.           衡整體資本結構。

39. CONTINGENT LIABILITIES                                                                       39. 或然負債
      On 3 August 2011, Annuity & Re Life Ltd (the “Petitioner”), the non-                         於二零一一年八月三日，建滔銅箔集
      controlling shareholder of Kingboard Copper Foil Holdings Limited                            團有限公司（「建滔銅箔」）非控股股東
      (“KBCF”), presented a petition in the Supreme Court of Bermuda                                                   （「呈請人」）根據一
                                                                                                   Annuity & Re Life Ltd
      (the “Petition”) in respect of KBCF against its controlling shareholders                     項指建滔銅箔事務已經或現正進行的方
      based on a complaint that the affairs of KBCF had been and/or                                式乃壓搾或不合理地不利於呈請人的投
      were being conducted in a manner which was oppressive or unfairly                            訴，針對建滔銅箔控股股東向百慕達高
      prejudicial to the Petitioner.                                                               級法院遞交呈請書（「呈請」）。

      The controlling shareholders of KBCF were eventually successful in                           建滔銅箔控股股東最終於二零一七年三
